# Drug Channels

> > Drug Channels provides expert analysis of pharmaceutical distribution, pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs), specialty pharmacies, and drug pricing policy in the U.S. healthcare system.

Published by the Drug Channels Institute (acquired by HMP Global in 2024), this site covers critical industry topics including PBM operations, the 340B program, patient access challenges, and the impact of the Inflation Reduction Act on medication affordability and market dynamics.

## Key Topics

- Pharmacy Benefit Managers (PBMs)
- Drug Pricing & Affordability
- Patient Access & Medication Access
- Specialty Pharmacy & Specialty Drugs
- 340B Drug Pricing Program
- Prior Authorization
- Copay Accumulators & Maximizers
- Inflation Reduction Act (IRA)
- CVS Health, Express Scripts, OptumRx
- Medicare Part B & Part D
- Amazon Pharmacy
- Patient Adherence & Support Programs
- Formulary Exclusions
- Buy-and-Bill Reimbursement
- Discount Cards & GoodRx
